description: Swell customers and recent orders in Gorgias, open tickets in Swell
name: Gorgias

images.title: Recent Swell orders beside the ticket
images.description: When a Swell customer writes in, the Gorgias sidebar shows their profile and five latest orders, with items, tracking and links to Swell.

images.title: Open tickets in Swell
images.description: Each customer gets a Support tab with their open ticket count and latest ticket, and the customer list gets an Open tickets column.

images.title: Customers synced to Gorgias
images.description: With sync on, customers are created in Gorgias with name, email and phone, linked to Swell, and updated as their details change.

images.title: Connected in minutes
images.description: Enter your Gorgias subdomain, agent email and API key, and save. The app creates the integration and sidebar widget for you.
